description: Poll a quote job until complete, then show the human the quotes. Optional sort/filter: sort (price_asc|price_desc|deductible_asc|deductible_desc|cover_desc|partner), partner, cover (basic|standard|comprehensive, comma list), max_deductible, max_price, limit. The human picks which quote to continue with. NEXT STEP after quotes: nothing is bought until a person approves. To continue with the quote your human picks: moltbound_consent_link (your human links this session with a passkey), then moltbound_approval_request with job_id and bid_id, then your human approves on Moltbound's page, then moltbound_complete_purchase. Every quote reply also has a next_step object with these calls filled in. No human available? Test it with moltbound_human_sim_start. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.
name: moltbound_quote_status
